build_reproject_local_to_global: build a python module that reprojects local 3D point cloud coordinates to global frame using a 4x4 pose matrix
create_project_tps_into_worldmap: create a function that converts 4x4 trajectory pose matrices into 2D map cell coordinates for topdown visualization
test_planned_path2tps: test the planned_path2tps function to convert a list of 2D planner path coordinates into 4x4 trajectory pose matrices
refactor_get_direction: refactor the get_direction function to compute the rotation angle needed between two 4x4 pose matrices with configurable thresholds
summarize_project_tps_into_worldmap_nump: summarize the numpy version of project_tps_into_worldmap that converts pose matrices to map cell coordinates using numpy arrays
